Core implementation (src/maintenance): - src/maintenance/index.ts - Exports maintenance API functions: - detectStaleAnnotations - updateAnnotationReferences - batchUpdateAnnotations - verifyAnnotations - generateMaintenanceReport - JSDoc ties module to docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md and all REQ-MAINT-* IDs.
- src/maintenance/detect.ts (REQ-MAINT-DETECT) - export function detectStaleAnnotations(codebasePath: string): string[] - Resolves a workspaceRoot from process.cwd() and codebasePath. - If workspaceRoot does not exist or is not a directory, returns []. - Uses getAllFiles(workspaceRoot) to recursively list files. - For each file, processFileForStaleAnnotations reads content and matches /@story\s+([^\s]+)/g. - handleStoryMatch: - Skips unsafe or invalid story paths via isUnsafeStoryPath(storyPath). - Computes project and codebase candidates with path.resolve. - Uses enforceProjectBoundary to ensure candidates are within workspaceRoot. - Only calls fs.existsSync on in-project candidates. - If no in-project candidate exists on disk, adds the original storyPath to a Set. - Returns a de-duplicated array of stale story paths. - Includes branch-level @story/@req comments referencing REQ-MAINT-DETECT and security validation behavior.
- src/maintenance/update.ts (REQ-MAINT-UPDATE) - export function updateAnnotationReferences(codebasePath, oldPath, newPath): number - Returns 0 if codebasePath does not exist or is not a directory. - Escapes oldPath to a safe regex fragment and builds /(@story\s*)oldPath/g. - Uses getAllFiles(codebasePath) to list files. - processFileForAnnotationUpdates: - Skips non-regular files. - Reads content, uses String.replace with a callback that preserves the '@story ' prefix and substitutes newPath. - Increments a shared counter for each replacement. - Writes back only if newContent !== content. - Returns the total count of updated @story annotations. - JSDoc and inline comments reference REQ-MAINT-UPDATE.
- src/maintenance/batch.ts (REQ-MAINT-BATCH, REQ-MAINT-VERIFY) - export function batchUpdateAnnotations(codebasePath, mappings): number - Loops over mappings {oldPath, newPath}, calls updateAnnotationReferences for each, and sums counts. - export function verifyAnnotations(codebasePath): boolean - Calls detectStaleAnnotations(codebasePath) and returns stale.length === 0. - JSDoc references REQ-MAINT-BATCH and REQ-MAINT-VERIFY.
- src/maintenance/report.ts (REQ-MAINT-REPORT, REQ-MAINT-SAFE) - export function generateMaintenanceReport(codebasePath): string - Calls detectStaleAnnotations(codebasePath). - If no stale annotations: returns "" (empty string) as a safe no-op signal. - Otherwise joins stale annotation paths with '\n' and returns the string. - JSDoc explicitly documents behavior and ties to REQ-MAINT-REPORT and REQ-MAINT-SAFE.
- src/maintenance/utils.ts (shared traversal used by detection and updates) - export function getAllFiles(dir): string[] - Validates dir exists and is a directory; otherwise returns []. - Recursively traverses via traverseDirectory, collecting only regular files. - traverseDirectory uses fs.readdirSync, fs.statSync, recurses into subdirectories, and pushes file paths into an array. - All key branches have @story and @req tags referencing docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md, giving traceability back to this story.
CLI implementation and commands (REQ-MAINT-*, especially REQ-MAINT-SAFE and UX): - src/maintenance/commands.ts - Exports exit codes: EXIT_OK = 0, EXIT_STALE = 1, EXIT_USAGE = 2. - export function handleDetect(normalized): number - Parses flags via parseFlags(normalized). - Calls detectStaleAnnotations(root). - If --json: console.log(JSON.stringify({ root, stale })). - If no stale: prints "No stale @story annotations found.". - If stale: prints each stale story then a summary with guidance to run 'report'. - Returns EXIT_OK when none stale, EXIT_STALE otherwise. - export function handleVerify(normalized): number - Calls verifyAnnotations(root). - On success: prints "All traceability annotations under are valid." and returns EXIT_OK. - On failure: prints a guidance message and returns EXIT_STALE. - export function handleReport(normalized): number - Supports flags.format with default 'text'. - If format === 'json': prints JSON { root, report }. - Else if report empty: prints "No stale @story annotations found. Nothing to report.". - Else prints a Markdown-style header and "Stale story references:" followed by the report string. - Always returns EXIT_OK. - export function handleUpdate(normalized): number - Validates required flags.from and flags.to. If missing, prints error to console.error and returns EXIT_USAGE (later causing CLI to also print help). - If flags.dryRun: - Computes beforeReport via generateMaintenanceReport(root). - Derives estimatedStaleCount from number of lines in beforeReport. - If --json: prints a JSON object { mode: 'dry-run', root, from, to, estimatedStaleCount }. - Else prints textual summary including "Dry run: no files were modified." and the estimated impact. - Returns EXIT_OK. - Else: - Calls updateAnnotationReferences(root, from, to) to perform real updates. - If --json: prints JSON { root, from, to, updated: count }. - Else prints human-readable summary including the count. - Returns EXIT_OK.
- src/maintenance/cli.ts - Declares shebang (#!/usr/bin/env node) for CLI use. - export function runMaintenanceCli(rawArgv: string[]): number - Normalizes args via normalizeCliArgs. - If no subcommand or -h/--help: calls printHelp(), returns EXIT_OK. - Switches on subcommand and delegates: - detect -> handleDetect - verify -> handleVerify - report -> handleReport - update -> handleUpdate (and prints help if handler returns EXIT_USAGE) - default: prints "Unknown command: ", prints help, returns EXIT_USAGE. - Wraps the dispatch in try/catch: - On error: prints "traceability-maint failed: " and returns EXIT_USAGE. - function printHelp(): void - Prints a detailed multi-line usage string describing commands and options: - Commands: detect, verify, report, update. - Options: --root, --json, --format, --from, --to, --dry-run, -h/--help. - if (require.main === module) { process.exit(runMaintenanceCli(process.argv)); } - Makes the file executable as a CLI entry point. - All behavior is annotated with @story docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md and corresponding REQ-MAINT-* tags.
Plugin integration: - src/index.ts - Imports maintenance functions from './maintenance'. - Declares const maintenance = { detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations, generateMaintenanceReport }. - Exports { rules, configs, maintenance } and default { rules, configs, maintenance }. - JSDoc references REQ-MAINTENANCE-API-EXPORT for this story, confirming that maintenance APIs are integrated into the main plugin export. - package.json - "bin": { "traceability-maint": "lib/src/maintenance/cli.js" } - Ensures that after build, the CLI is available as traceability-maint, matching documentation.

traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS appear to be fully implemented. The project provides: - Core functionality: detectStaleAnnotations, updateAnnotationReferences, batchUpdateAnnotations, verifyAnnotations, and generateMaintenanceReport implement detection, updating, batch operations, and verification of @story annotation references against the filesystem, with security-aware path handling. - Integration: The maintenance API is exported from the main plugin module, and a dedicated CLI (traceability-maint) is wired via the package.json bin field. The CLI uses the same maintenance logic and is documented for use in local scripts and CI. - Quality and safety: update operations are narrowly scoped to @story path substrings, preserve other code and formatting, and validate directories before acting. Dry-run mode, explicit exit codes, and robust error handling (including permissions and invalid flags) satisfy REQ-MAINT-SAFE and the quality/error-handling acceptance criteria. - User experience: CLI commands (detect, verify, report, update) provide clear textual or JSON feedback about stale annotations, actions taken, or planned changes, and help text is printed when no command or help flags are used. - Documentation: The README and user-docs/api-reference.md document the Maintenance API and CLI with concrete examples that match the implementation. Tests under tests/maintenance explicitly validate each requirement and confirm behavior across edge cases (missing roots, nested directories, permission errors, unsafe paths, non-existent mappings, dry-run, invalid formats). The available evidence therefore supports a PASSED assessment for this story.
